findings.claim: FY2026 10-K 描述的客戶與通路仍為 OEM、批發商、經銷商、承包商與終端用戶並存，未見訂閱化／D2C／平台化等結構性商業模式轉變的描述；資料中心為新增成長客群。
findings.excerpt: Customers for these coolers and refrigeration products primarily include wholesalers, distributors and resellers, commercial and industrial OEMs, as well as contractors and end users in a variety of commercial and industrial applications

findings.claim: Modine 北美暖通銷售主管稱產品全經經銷商、不直銷（暖通部門通路仍為經銷商模式）
findings.source: HVACR Trends, Modine market outlook 2026 (Richard Boothman)
findings.excerpt: The rep, the distributor, and the contractor all play a role. Training gives us a meaningful way to add value without bypassing the channel. How do you balance that without going around the distributor? Everything runs through the distributor. They host the training and invite their contractors. We do not sell direct.

note: 兩次搜尋未找到 2026 年通路去中介化或商業模式轉型的一手來源；僅見低可信行銷部落格宣稱直銷，與公司說法不一致，未採用。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
